text.autoconfig.farlandsprobe.title: FarLandsProbe Settings
text.autoconfig.farlandsprobe.option.lig: Force every block/entity light level to 15 and remove the darkness fog.
text.autoconfig.farlandsprobe.option.bor: Disable the built-in world border: collision wall, damage, red vignette and position clamping.
Remove the invisible wall at ±30,000,000 (Player.tick, absSnapTo, clampHorizontal).
text.autoconfig.farlandsprobe.option.bou: Allow spawning, teleporting, interaction and height queries anywhere (Level bounds checks pass).
Remove chunk validity checks so generation can continue past ±33,553,360 blocks.
text.autoconfig.farlandsprobe.option.enc: Repack section coordinates as X22/Y22/Z20: X and Y both reach ±33,554,432 blocks (Y is enough for the sky far lands around 25,101,647), Z is reduced to ±8,388,608 blocks.
text.autoconfig.farlandsprobe.option.sta: When a move packet wraps coordinates, skip collision and setPos directly to avoid freezing the server thread.
Crash guard for long overflow in entity section range lookups.
NPE guard when the lighting engine hits a section with no light data.
Overflow-safe corridor midpoint (x0+(x1-x0)/2) in mineshaft placement.
Disable the aquifer when its grid size is absurd, avoiding huge allocations (OOM).
Fix the renderer octree bounds overflowing near ±2^31 so blocks keep rendering.
Skip structure generation beyond ±63,000,000 chunks to avoid coordinate-overflow OOM.
